About

NEWRONIQ is a UK-based technology consultancy focused on enterprise AI strategy and architecture.

Our expertise spans enterprise architecture, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, software engineering and security.

We work with organisations to assess technology opportunities, evaluate architectural choices and develop practical plans for implementation.

Understand the problem before recommending technology.
